full_name: Stephen Mann | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Physical Sciences Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow and Wyss Institute Fellow University of Bristol (United Kingdom)
bio: Stephen Mann is a professor of chemistry, the director of the Centre for Organized Matter Chemistry, and a principal of the Bristol Centre for Functional Nanomaterials at the University of Bristol.
